authors.bio: Gilles Bergeron is the Deputy Minister of Communications, Government of Quebec, 930 Chemin Ste-Foy, Quebec 6, P.Q. Prior to this position he was Deputy Minister of Education, and was in charge of the Telesat communications satellite. M. Bergeron also held positions in several companies as an industrial engineer. He received his education from the University of Montreal - Polytechnic and the University of Toronto.
